agent_priors_used: General prior (not SPIDER evidence): a benchmark whose cold and strongest comparator sit at the correctness ceiling has no dynamic range and cannot discriminate a treatment at any sample size; dynamic range must be certified before freeze.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): auxiliary memory/skill machinery carries real token, latency and maintenance overhead and can be beaten by a budget-matched vanilla agent; the honest comparison is fully loaded cost per successful task, not marginal cache-hit rate.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): long-horizon agent failure is driven more by salience/path dependence and observation over-ingestion than by raw context length, so mismatch-triggered re-grounding (when to abandon an inherited procedure) is a distinct mechanism from another freshness estimator.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): prompt specification and model capability are separable failure modes, and a localized capability bar (minimal parseable action + completion) should be tested before paying for a full multi-arm benchmark.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): local resource optima and path dependence make a lane continue its last question by inertia; a pre-freeze design that can abort cheaply on an unsatisfiable sampling frame/certificate is preferable to a frozen run that spends an EXECUTE cycle on an empty frame.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): a prerequisite failure rediscovered as MEASUREMENT_INVALID across several lanes is better repaired once (a shared instrument or substrate fix) than retried per experiment.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: This is a continuity cycle: the immediately preceding Director already re-aimed every lane at the program's real bottleneck, and no accepted evidence has appeared since (the six active experiments are all still PREFREEZE except Physics, which is FROZEN), so the correct decision is to preserve each in-flight transaction rather than churn objectives. Effective claim state is unchanged: C-MEAS-VALID VALIDATED only at a bounded authorship-separated real-Chromium fixture scope; C-PARAM-INHERIT, C-FRESHNESS, C-DELTA-REPAIR and C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY EXPERIMENTAL inside narrow scopes; C-LLM-INHERIT, C-PRODUCT-ECON, C-CROSSSITE, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE and C-WEB-DYNAMICS still HYPOTHESIS. The strategic-to-product bottleneck is exactly the three verified blockers (audit PROGRAM_AUDIT_GLOBAL_2026-10-10): B1 no promoted parameterized carrier in src/spider/kernel.py (distill() is literal at confidence 0.5 below the 0.8 resolve threshold and distill_parameterized() is absent); B2 cold and retrieval-shaped comparators sit at 1.0 correctness on the mandatory-discovery deterministic credential-free REST class, so no treatment can discriminate; B3 no tested CPU-quantized 3B-8B endpoint clears the minimal click-then-answer bar, so the four-arm benchmark cannot run. Each active mandate maps onto exactly one of these, and each is a cheap, decision-shaped test rather than another narrative: Product -> B1 kernel installation/promotion with a positive and a known-negative/refusal certificate; Runtime -> B2 non-degenerate asymmetric-discovery task-bank certification with a bounded substrate-class negative as a legitimate exit; Intel -> B3 prompt-underspecification vs capability, yielding a bounded local-endpoint class negative if the bar is not cleared. Graph continues a v2-controlled removal of the joint-authorship confound on C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE, the consumer entry point of the inheritance layer; Frontier completes the v2 re-design of the site-native-discovery question whose v1 was BLOCKED on an empty sampling frame (a design defect, not science); Physics must complete its frozen access-barrier stationarity transaction. With 255/434 R2 packets REVISE or MEASUREMENT_INVALID (58.8%, of which 26.0% MEASUREMENT_INVALID), the dominant risk is again paying for a redundant or non-discriminating packet; therefore no lane is redirected into a thread that the audit, the current Codex, or the pre-2.0 record already closed, and no expensive C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON execution is funded until all three readiness conditions hold. No lane is idle or stalled before freeze; the one transient BLOCKED outcome (Frontier v1) and the one FROZEN outcome (Physics) are both handled inside the preserved transactions.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Scout brief was treated as staff advice and cross-checked against the Codex and the machine snapshot. It did not manufacture a new direction; it sharpened three things I adopted into the rationale. First, it correctly localized the program to B1/B2/B3 and confirmed that every lane is non-idle, so my job is preservation plus one judgement per lane rather than reactivation. Second, its external reconnaissance (MemoryArena, Odysseys, Agentic Plan Caching, SkillWeaver/AWM/ASI, WebChallenger, Stagehand decay semantics, and the budget-matched-vanilla warning) raised the comparator bar and reinforced that SPIDER must not claim economics against weak baselines; I did not, however, adopt its suggestion to switch the program onto an external benchmark now, because that route still requires readiness condition 3 (a capable endpoint) which Intel is testing, and because Runtime's active mandate already contains a bounded substrate-class-negative exit that would itself force that decision on real evidence. Third, its prior that cross-site generalization is the hard case and that per-site skill libraries dominate informed my disposition to keep the Frontier discovery question (a prerequisite for framing any cross-site/library claim) rather than terminate it, while recording Intel prior-art verification as a dependency before freeze. I explicitly did not let the Scout's 'local attractor' framing force a pivot: after a cognitive reset on Graph and Runtime, their inherited directions still won on merits (a real confound and a real unfedable-discriminator blocker), and the Scout itself concedes both are not idle. Its candidate directions that I did not fund this cycle (mismatch-triggered abandonment for Graph, external-benchmark adoption for Runtime, comparator reproduction for Intel) are held as live alternatives for later cycles rather than rejected.
